first.title: Mataki ɗaya kafin in amsa
first.text: {name}: ana buƙatar ƙwaƙwalwa don yin tunani — sabis da ke rubuta amsoshi. Hanya mafi sauri kyauta ce.
first.freeText: Asusu kyauta a shafin OpenRouter, sannan a dawo nan.
first.also: Har ila yau, ƙwaƙwalwa ta sirri don wannan kwamfutar
first.alsoText: {size}, za a sauke a bayan fage, don abin da ya kamata ya zauna a wannan kwamfutar.
first.plans: Ina amfani da ChatGPT, Claude ko Copilot tuni
first.plansText: Amsa da shirin da ake biya, ko da makulli
first.choose: Na fi son in zaɓa da kaina
first.chooseText: Na sirri, da sauri, ko amsoshi mafi kyau
first.neutral: {name}: babu wata alaƙa da OpenRouter, ko da wani sabis a nan. Ana iya canza shi a kowane lokaci a Saituna.
first.private: Kalmomina su zauna a wannan kwamfutar
first.privateText: Ƙwaƙwalwa ta sirri a nan, ana sauke ta sau ɗaya ({size}). Amsoshi masu sauƙi kuma a hankali, kuma tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
first.privateNo: Wannan kwamfutar ba za ta iya gudanar da ƙwaƙwalwa ta sirri ba.
first.nowText: Asusu kyauta a shafin OpenRouter, a shirye cikin minti ɗaya. Yana da iyaka ta kowace rana, kuma amsoshi suna zuwa daga gajimare.
first.best: Ina son amsoshi mafi kyau da za a iya samu
first.bestText: Da sabis na biya: shirin ChatGPT, Claude ko Copilot da ake da shi tuni, ko makulli daga ɗaya daga cikinsu.
first.names: Waɗannan sunaye na kamfanoninsu ne. {name}: babu alaƙa da ko ɗaya daga cikinsu.
first.downloading: Ana sauke ƙwaƙwalwa ta sirri ({size}). Har sai ta shirya, amsoshi suna zuwa daga gajimare.
